scope: Close the previously missing nonzero stack-XP upgrade/recruit/save-load regression. No gameplay defect observed in these two cases.
sourceCase: Unchanged production profiles:200XP/unit,count2,total400;paid upgrade retains75% =>150/unit,total300;recruit one untrained unit =>100/unit,count3,total300;save/reload and effective popup preserved.
fixtureChanges: Four-object map with owned town/hero/gnoll and enemy town
Gnoll400HP and inactive/no-counter for controlled fight;peasant companion10000HP
No commanders in this owned browser fixture;production settings untouched
Source profiles unchanged in source case;accelerated thresholds only in named control case
knownLimitations: Bounded Castle chain,not every troop/army composition or full ERA compatibility
Integer remainder boundaries and unrelated source options are not claimed by these cases
Captured raw client logs are post-reload;browser error listener covers whole execution
harnessDifference: Final reusable harness moves passed assignment after error checks, fixes CLI labels, and always creates/closes its own fresh context. Both recorded runs already used that fresh-context branch and the native command sequence is unchanged. Exact executed harness archived.
